meta.title: How Pricing Works
meta.description: What you pay on WagStays: the sitter's own rate, extra pets, statutory holiday rates and puppy surcharges, plus a flat fee, WagShield vet cover and HST. Worked examples and FAQ.

twoDogs.title: 2 dogs on the same walk
twoDogs.note: {price} per walk, +{extra} for the second dog.

christmas.title: 2 dogs, 3 nights over Christmas
christmas.note: Boarding at {price} a night, {holiday} on statutory holidays, +{extra} per extra pet per night. Check-in Dec 24, check-out Dec 27, {year}.

puppy.title: 1 puppy, 2 nights of boarding
puppy.note: Biscuit is 6 months old: +{surcharge} per night on top of {price}.

hero.title: How pricing works
hero.intro: You pay the sitter's own rate, plus a flat service fee, WagShield vet cover and HST. Extra pets, statutory holidays and puppies can add a little — always shown before you book.

whatYouPay.title: What you pay
whatYouPay.sitterPriceText: Set by the sitter, per walk, night, day or visit. It includes one pet.
whatYouPay.wagShieldText: Flat, per booking. Emergency vet care up to {amount}.
whatYouPay.serviceFeeText: Flat, per booking — never a percentage. Secure payments, verification and support.
whatYouPay.hstText: Ontario's Harmonized Sales Tax on the sitter's price and fees (after any WagPoints).
whatYouPay.summary: A {price} walk comes to {total} all in. Your card isn't charged until the sitter accepts your request.

extraPets.title: Extra pets
extraPets.text: The sitter's price covers your first pet. Sitters who take more than one pet set a price for each extra pet (per walk, night, day or visit) and the most pets they take in one booking. You'll see it on every profile as “Each extra dog +{extra} per walk (up to 2 dogs)” — or “One pet per booking” when a sitter only takes one.
extraPets.together: Booking two pets together is usually cheaper than two separate bookings — the fees are charged once. Two separate walks would be {total}. Searching with 2 pets shows only sitters who take that many.

holidays.title: Statutory holiday rates
holidays.text: Some sitters charge a holiday rate on statutory holidays. It replaces their usual price for that walk, night, day or visit only — the summary names each holiday and shows the difference.
holidays.observed: Holiday rates use the holiday itself, not a weekday it's observed on.

puppies.title: Puppy surcharge
puppies.text: Puppies under 1 year need more attention — extra potty breaks, chewing patrol, training. Some sitters add a small surcharge per puppy, per walk, night, day or visit. We use the age in your pet's profile, so keep it up to date.

weekly.title: Weekly recurring bookings
weekly.text: Booking the same walk or visit every week? Each week is its own booking with its own price: the service fee, WagShield cover and HST apply to each one, and a week that lands on a statutory holiday uses the holiday rate. Your WagPoints discount comes off the first booking. The checkout shows the first booking and the total for all weeks.

capacity.title: How many pets can a sitter take?
capacity.walks: Walks and drop-in visits: up to the number the sitter sets per walk or visit (“up to 2 dogs”).
capacity.boarding: Boarding and day care: each pet also takes one of the sitter's places at home. Two pets need two free places on every night or day — if a date is full, the calendar tells you before you book.

cancellations.title: Cancellations & refunds
cancellations.charged: Your card won't be charged until the sitter accepts your request.
cancellations.refund: Cancel in one tap for a 100% refund, no fees, up to 24 hours before your start time.
cancellations.declined: If the sitter declines, you aren't charged. WagPoints used on a cancelled or declined booking go back to your balance automatically.
cancellations.guarantee: Not happy? Get a free rebooking or a full refund under our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.

wagpoints.title: WagPoints
wagpoints.text: You earn {pct}% of the sitter's price back in WagPoints when a booking is completed (a {price} walk earns {earn}). At checkout, up to {max} of your balance comes off a booking, before HST. You can see your balance under Account → WagPoints.

faq.title: Questions pet parents ask
faq.chargedA: Only when the sitter accepts your request. Sending a booking request is free, and so is a Meet & Greet before you book.
faq.percentQ: Is the service fee a percentage of my booking?
faq.percentA: No. It's a flat {fee} per booking, whatever the sitter charges. WagShield vet cover is also a flat {cover} per booking.
faq.secondPetQ: Why can't I add my second pet to a booking?
faq.secondPetA: Each sitter decides how many pets they take at once for each service. If a service shows “One pet per booking”, that sitter only takes one pet for it. Use “Number of pets” in search to see sitters who take more than one.
faq.holidaysQ: Which days count as statutory holidays?
faq.holidaysA: The statutory holidays of the sitter's province. In Ontario: New Year's Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Civic Holiday, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day and Boxing Day. Each sitter profile has a “Which days?” link with the next dates.
faq.puppyQ: How do you know my pet is a puppy?
faq.puppyA: From the age in your pet's profile. Pets under 1 year old count as puppies. If the sitter has no puppy surcharge, nothing is added.
faq.weeklyQ: Do fees and HST apply to every weekly visit?
faq.weeklyA: Yes. Each weekly visit or stay is its own booking, priced on its own date — so a visit that falls on a holiday can cost a little more. Your WagPoints discount comes off the first one.
faq.cancelA: Cancel in one tap for a 100% refund, no fees, up to 24 hours before your start time. Any WagPoints you used are returned to your balance automatically.
faq.earnsQ: Does the sitter get the whole sitter's price?
faq.earnsA: The sitter's price (including extra pets, holiday rates and puppy surcharges) is what the sitter earns. The WagShield cover, service fee and HST are added on top for you.

cta.title: Ready to find a sitter?
cta.text: Every price is on the profile — no sign-up needed to look.
